body.en: Python and common code and configuration files (JavaScript, Rust, Go, C and C++, Java, Ruby, R, shell scripts, JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSS, SQL and more) can be created, dropped in, searched and attached to the agent, and their editors offer autocompletion.
body.zh: Python 以及常见的代码和配置文件（JavaScript、Rust、Go、C 和 C++、Java、Ruby、R、Shell 脚本、JSON、YAML、TOML、XML、CSS、SQL 等）现在可以新建、拖入、搜索并附加给AI 助手，编辑这些文件时还有自动补全。

body.en: After signing out you can sign in with a different account. Sign out and Cancel now really end a sign-in in progress, and ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z work in the sign-in window.
body.zh: 退出登录后可以换一个账号重新登录。“退出登录”和“取消”现在会真正结束正在进行的登录，登录窗口中也能使用 ⌘Z 和 ⇧⌘Z。

title.en: The agent panel remembers your setup
title.zh: AI 助手面板记住你的设置

body.en: Your default provider, model, effort, hidden providers, provider order and drafts are kept across launches, and Settings → Agent providers has a Default provider row.
body.zh: 默认提供商、模型、推理强度、隐藏的提供商、提供商顺序和草稿在重新启动后都会保留，“设置 → AI 助手 → 模型”页面新增了“默认提供商”一行。

fixes.en: Hovering a command inside a formula no longer opens its description over the live math preview.
fixes.zh: 在公式中悬停命令时，不再在实时数学预览上方弹出命令说明。

fixes.en: Versions shows the right timeline and restores correctly for a project inside a larger Git repository, and a refused restore no longer leaves a stray auto-saved version.
fixes.zh: 位于更大 Git 仓库中的项目，其版本时间线和恢复操作现在都正确无误；被拒绝的恢复也不再留下多余的自动保存版本。

fixes.en: Zoomed panels stay on screen in narrow windows.
fixes.zh: 在较窄的窗口中，放大的面板会保持在屏幕内。

fixes.en: The terminal no longer freezes on heavy output when it opens.
fixes.zh: 终端打开时遇到大量输出不再卡住。

fixes.en: A pipe or other special file ending in .pdf no longer stalls PDF reading.
fixes.zh: 以 .pdf 结尾的管道或其他特殊文件不再导致 PDF 读取卡住。

fixes.en: Literature search no longer answers from an out-of-date index after two searches clash.
fixes.zh: 两次搜索冲突后，文献搜索不再使用过期的索引作答。

fixes.en: The app starts with a little less code to load.
fixes.zh: 应用启动时需要加载的代码又少了一些。
